message: npmScopes.types.npmMinimalAgeGate in .yarnrc.yml is 0, so Yarn 4.18.1 applies no release-age delay to @types packages, which depcurfew.json does not exempt
fix: Set npmScopes.types.npmMinimalAgeGate: 4320 in .yarnrc.yml, or add "@types/*" to cooldown.exclude in depcurfew.json if the scope needs no delay

message: npmScopes.corp in .yarnrc.yml sets no npmMinimalAgeGate, so Yarn 4.18.1 gives @corp packages its default of 1 day instead of the global npmMinimalAgeGate, shorter than 3d in depcurfew.json
fix: Set npmScopes.corp.npmMinimalAgeGate: 4320 in .yarnrc.yml, or add "@corp/*" to cooldown.exclude in depcurfew.json if the scope needs no delay

message: npmScopes.slow.npmMinimalAgeGate in .yarnrc.yml makes Yarn 4.18.1 wait 1 hour for @slow packages instead of the global npmMinimalAgeGate, shorter than 3d in depcurfew.json
fix: Set npmScopes.slow.npmMinimalAgeGate: 4320 in .yarnrc.yml, or add "@slow/*" to cooldown.exclude in depcurfew.json if the scope needs no delay
